title: On Staff & sign-in, a screen reader hears the same button names on every person, with no name
what: Each person on the Staff & sign-in list has the buttons Make sign-in code, Sign out everywhere and Remove, and a Trainer tick. A screen reader reads them only by those words, so moving through the buttons gives 'Remove, Remove, Remove' and 'Trainer, Trainer' with no sign of whose they are. Remove and Sign out everywhere cannot be undone.
expected: Each button and tick says whose it is to a screen reader, for example 'Remove Suresh' or 'Suresh is a trainer'.
who: owners who use a screen reader
fix_line: Give each person's buttons and tick a spoken name that includes the person's name; the shared button already allows this

title: Forgot your PIN, Other ways back in and Sign out look like grey words, not buttons
what: On the sign-in card, 'Forgot your PIN?' is grey bold words with no outline, no fill and no underline. The same plain look is used for 'Can't use WhatsApp? Other ways back in', for Sign out on the terms screen, and for the red Remove word on the staff list. A first-time owner who is locked out may not see that the words can be tapped, and these are the ways back in.
expected: Every tappable thing has an outline, a fill or an underline, so it plainly looks tappable, most of all the ways back in after a forgotten PIN.
fix_line: Give the plain button style an outline or an underline, or use the outlined style for these ways back in

title: While waiting for the WhatsApp message, a screen reader reads the waiting line out again every minute
what: The 'Waiting for your message. The code works for N more minutes.' line is marked as a live message, and its minutes go down every minute and its words change when the check starts. Each change makes a screen reader read the whole line out again while the person is busy in WhatsApp or scanning the code.
expected: The waiting line is read out once; the minutes left stay on screen without being read out each time.
who: owners who use a screen reader
fix_line: Keep the minutes-left words outside the live message, or read out only the change from waiting to checked

title: The 'Other ways back in' button does not tell a screen reader whether the list is open
what: Tapping 'Can't use WhatsApp? Other ways back in' shows or hides a box under it, but the button never says if the box is open or shut, and the shared button has no way to say so. A screen reader user hears nothing change after the tap.
expected: The button says open or closed, and the box that appears is announced or reached next.
who: owners who use a screen reader
fix_line: Let the shared button say expanded or collapsed, and use it on this toggle

title: No automatic accessibility check ever looks at sign-in, new gym, Forgot PIN, WhatsApp check or the terms screen
what: The panel's automatic accessibility crawl visits only signed-in pages of the demo gym, in the dark look only. The sign-in card, Create my gym, Forgot your PIN, the WhatsApp number check and the terms screen are never visited, and the light look is never checked by it. Staff & sign-in is visited only in the demo gym, where the people list is not shown.
expected: The crawl also opens the signed-out screens and Staff & sign-in with people listed, in both looks.
fix_line: Add the signed-out screens and a light-look pass to the accessibility crawl
